# Helper functions

            close(100.0 * 150 * 0.85, 1e-9),
        ),
    ],
)
def test_subtotal_calculation(items: Dict[str, Tuple[float, int]], expected_subtotal: float):

    for name, (price, qty) in items.items():
        c.add_item(name, price, qty)
    assert close(c.subtotal(), expected_subtotal)

@ pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "items, coupon, member, expected_total",
    [
        (
            {"x": (10.0, 1)},   # no bulk discount; subtotal=10
            None,
            False,
            close(10 + cart.shipping_fee(10), 1e-9),  # shipping 60
        ),
        (
            {"y": (50.0, 3)},   # no bulk discount; subtotal=150
            "SAVE20",           # 20% off -> 120
            True,
            close(120 + cart.shipping_fee(120, member=True), 1e-9),  # shipping half of 60 =30
        ),
        (
            {"z": (100.0, 200)},# subtotal before discount: 20000 -> bulk 15% => 17000
            "SAVE50",           # 50% off -> 8500
            False,
            close(8500 + cart.shipping_fee(8500), 1e-9),
        ),
    ],
)
def test_total_calculation(items: Dict[str, Tuple[float, int]], coupon: str | None, member: bool, expected_total):
    c = cart.Cart()
    for name, (price, qty) in items.items():
        c.add_item(name, price, qty)
    total = c.total(member=member, coupon=coupon)
    assert close(total, expected_total)

# Total on empty cart should be zero (no shipping)
def test_total_empty_cart_no_shipping():
    c = cart.Cart()
    assert close(c.total(), 0.0)

# Invalid coupon in total raises ValueError
@ pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "coupon",
    ["INVALID", "SAVE101"],
)
def test_total_invalid_coupon(coupon: str):
    c = cart.Cart()
    c.add_item("item", 10.0, 1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        c.total(coupon=coupon)

# Shipping fee applied after coupon deduction in total calculation
@ pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "subtotal, coupon_discount, expected_shipping",
    [
        (200.0, 20, cart.shipping_fee(180)),   # 20% off -> 180 -> shipping 60
        (1500.0, 10, cart.shipping_fee(1350)),# free shipping because subtotal>=1000 before coupon? but after coupon it's 1350>1000 still free
    ],
)
def test_shipping_applied_after_coupon(subtotal: float, coupon_discount: int, expected_shipping: float):
    # Construct cart manually to match subtotal calculation
    c = cart.Cart()
    # We'll just monkey patch subtotal and shipping_fee for this isolated check
    c.subtotal = lambda: subtotal  # type: ignore[assignment]
    total_before_ship = subtotal * (1 - coupon_discount / 100)
    expected_total = close(total_before_ship + cart.shipping_fee(total_before_ship), 1e-9)
    assert close(c.total(member=False, coupon=f"SAVE{coupon_discount}"), expected_total)

# End of test suite
